scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:extension && npm run build:cli
scripts.lint: biome lint src cli tests e2e *.config.js
scripts.format:check: biome ci src cli tests e2e *.config.js
scripts.e2e: npm run build:extension && npm run pack:cli && playwright test
scripts.pack:extension: npm run build:extension && rm -f dist/i2nclip.xpi && cd dist/extension && zip -q -r ../i2nclip.xpi .
scripts.pack:web: npm run build:web && rm -f dist/i2nclip-web.zip && cd dist/web && zip -q -r ../i2nclip-web.zip .
scripts.pack:cli: npm run build:cli && rm -f dist/i2nclip-cli.tar.gz && tar -czf dist/i2nclip-cli.tar.gz --transform=s,^cli,i2nclip-cli, -C dist cli
